title: Canonical profinite product sections and maps
statement: Let $T,T'$ be schemes and $P,P'$ profinite sets in the same arbitrary universe. Using the actual profinite test functor [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects] and scheme fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product], define $T[P]=\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{LC}(P,\mathbf Z)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}T$, with its projection $T[P]\to T$. For $q\in P$, its constant-label section $T\to T[P]$ is induced by evaluation of locally constant integer functions at $q$ and the identity of $T$. For a scheme morphism $f:T'\to T$ and a continuous map $a:P'\to P$, define $T'[P']\to T[P]$ by the pullback map induced by $\operatorname{LC}(P,\mathbf Z)\to\operatorname{LC}(P',\mathbf Z)$ and $f$. These are the actual scheme maps, including empty profinite sets, not maps merely of underlying point sets.
